identity.name: Tiffany Trace
identity.notes: Tiffany Trace is a small, gated residential neighborhood in Boca Raton, Palm Beach County, Florida, composed primarily of single-family homes. It is a quiet, low-density enclave within the city. Publicly documented specifics on HOA dues, CDD assessments, and community amenities are limited, so figures below are approximate or city-level.

fees.note: Range $433-$507/month per recent real estate listings (2024-2026 data); typically covers grounds maintenance, security, trash, water, sewer, sometimes cable/internet. Exact current fee, transfer fees, capital contributions, and special assessments not detailed in public sources. HOA managed by Allied Property Management Group, Inc. (1711 Worthington Rd, Suite 103, West Palm Beach, FL 33409). Amount recorded as low end of range; see note for full range. No CDD assessment found in any source read (community appears to be a plain HOA, not CDD-backed).

amenities.detail: Gated community entrance with controlled access; typical of small Boca Raton enclaves. No documented clubhouse, pool, or golf facilities specific to this community were found in available sources (may rely on nearby public facilities). Confidence is moderate — amenity list is likely incomplete rather than exhaustive-verified-absent. (ai-knowledge data, not from a specific web page.)
Gated entrance with 24-hour manned security; single-family gated community, ~64 homes built ~1987-1990, part of the Boca Country Club area (ZIP 33487)
Clubhouse listed among community amenities; specific community pool or fitness center details vary by source and were not verified
Access to golf course views and facilities via non-mandatory, non-equity membership at Boca Country Club; homes often feature golf/lake views and private pools
